data.body: S2c change 1953: CI Verified failed on patchset 1 via repo-wide contract test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout (new parser files bridge_arms.py + jira.py named legacy hyphenated aliases bridge-fsck/bridge-probe/jira-onboard). Fix (non-behavioral, matches precedent of _jira_onboard.py/bridge_fsck.py already in the set): added both compat parser files to _COMPATIBILITY_FILES; corrected jira.py docstring mislabel (bridge setup is primary, jira-onboard the retained alias). Contract 7/7 green, lint+typecheck+oracle green. Amended (Change-Id preserved), rebased clean onto origin/main 54469ca, pushed patchset 2. 2 local facade failures are environmental only (git safe.bareRepository=explicit on bare-repo helper), not code. LLM-Review+1 auto-removed on the new patchset (correct re-review-on-update behavior).
